solution_title: Split-Screen Real Estate Search, Parcel Polygon & Commute Explorer
summary: Zillow-style split-screen San Francisco real estate search, cadastral lot-boundary, and neighborhood commute explorer across all 8 web stacks. Features synchronized filterable property cards and custom HTML price-pill AdvancedMarkerElement markers with @googlemaps/markerclusterer clustering and bidirectional hover highlighting, cadastral parcel google.maps.Polygon outlines on selected listings, Terra Draw polygon search-area filtering (via google.maps.geometry.poly.containsLocation), roadmap/satellite map type toggle, embedded StreetViewPanorama neighborhood preview, live 5km nearby schools/groceries/transit discovery via Places API (New) searchNearby, and a live Driving + Transit workplace Commute Time Calculator powered by Routes API RouteMatrix.computeRouteMatrix (with server-side BFF proxy routes on Next.js, FastAPI, and Node.js Express). All stacks enforce zero-deprecation APIs, explicit field masks, mapId: 'DEMO_MAP_ID', and internalUsageAttributionIds: ['gmp_git_agentsamples_v1.0.0'].
gmp_products_used: Maps JavaScript API (Vector Map with mapId, Polygon cadastral boundaries, StreetViewPanorama, Geometry poly.containsLocation)
ui_layout_summary: Full-viewport split-screen layout with a 64px top search/filter bar (location PlaceAutocompleteElement, max price, min beds, property type filters, and live count badge), a 440px scrollable left column containing synchronized property cards and the selected listing detail drawer (parcel metadata, embedded 220px+ Street View panorama, 5km nearby schools/groceries/transit tabs + live Places list, and workplace Commute Time Calculator showing Driving and Transit ETAs), and a flex-1 right map pane (min-height: 560px) hosting the vector Google Map, floating top-left Terra Draw 'Draw Search Area' / 'Clear Area' and 'Roadmap / Satellite' controls, clustered HTML price-pill AdvancedMarkerElement pins, and the selected property's cadastral parcel Polygon outline.

backend_proxy_endpoints.purpose: Resolve neighborhood/address searches and workplace destinations via Places API (New) Text Search with explicit X-Goog-Api-Key and X-Goog-FieldMask headers.
Discover nearby schools, grocery stores, and transit stations within a 5km radius of the selected property via Places API (New) Nearby Search.
Compute real-time driving (TRAFFIC_AWARE) and public transit commute ETAs and distances between the selected property and the workplace destination via Routes API Compute Route Matrix.
Compute the encoded commute route polyline between the selected property and workplace destination for optional map overlay preview via Routes API Compute Routes.
